title: Compact-support composition with a source open
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring. Let V,X,S be Noetherian schemes, w:V→X an open immersion, and f:X→S separated of finite type and compactifiable [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. For a compactification c=(j,r) of f, its source restriction c.precomp w has open factor wj and proper factor r. Identify compact support along w with exact derived open extension using the identity-proper compactification (w,id), and use the model-to-chosen comparisons t_c and t_(c.precomp w). Then the specified composition isomorphism α_(w,f), after this open identification, is Dw_!(t_c inverse), followed by the inverse of derived open-composition D(wj)_!≅Dw_! Dj_! [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition], followed by t_(c.precomp w). The equality is one of the specified natural isomorphisms, on the whole unbounded derived categories. The open adjunctions have the normalization of [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction].

source.place: Tag 0F7J, lemma-shriek-composition: source-open specialization of the first two identifications; Tag 0F7B, identity-proper normalization of lemma-shriek-proper-and-open.

proof.text: Use the canonical composition comparison for the triangle with cf=(w,id_X), cg=c, cfg=c.precomp(w), q=c.i and p=id_(c.Z). Its proper/open square is cartesian with identity horizontal arrows. The identity-square exchange equation and the left unit equation for proper direct-image composition simplify its compositor to the inverse open compositor, preceded by the direct-image identity comparison. Identify this open compositor and identity comparison with the specified exact-derived ones. The every-triangle equation compares all three models to the chosen compactifications. Cancel the cf comparison against the definition of rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoOfIsOpenImmersion, then cancel the remaining direct-image identity comparison. Naturality of the cg comparison gives the displayed equality. The construction and unit equations include empty and identity opens.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0F7J, lemma-shriek-composition, specialized using an identity-proper triangle; Tag 0F7B, lemma-shriek-proper-and-open, identity-square normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso_open_source
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {V X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian V] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    (w : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion w]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasCompactification w] [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification (w ≫ f)]
    (c : Compactification f) :
    Functor.isoWhiskerRight (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoOfIsOpenImmersion A w).symm
        (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f) ≪≫
      unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A w f =
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) w).mapDerivedCategory
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A c).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight
        (mapDerivedCategoryOpenImmersionLowerShriekComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) w c.i).symm
        (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g) ≪≫
      rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A (c.precomp w)
